## Handover notes

- `a26-smart-contract--abi-stability-gate`: - `to_agent`: `A27` (audit scope) and `A28`/`A29` as consumers of `contract.abi`; the assigner when rejected. `decisions`: breaking or compatible and why; `artifacts`: ABI and diff with digests; `verification`: step 3 to 5 verdicts. - End with `shared_handover_validate`, then `shared_handover_write`.
- `a26-smart-contract--access-control-roles`: - `to_agent`: `A09`, with `A10` and `A27` as consumers of `code.patch`. `decisions`: primitive and role table; `open_questions`: holder addresses from A30; `verification`: matrix, event, plan verdicts. - End with `shared_handover_validate`, then `shared_handover_write`.
